rca of the issue: User's browser origin was https://lens-inspect-2.cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud (cluster host that the public lens-inspect-2 preview URL maps to). That origin was not in CORS_ORIGINS, so the security middleware's 403 branch fired on POSTs. Fix: added both lens-inspect-2 hosts (public + cluster-12) to CORS_ORIGINS, alongside the existing c4415e13 pair. Verified: middleware now accepts these origins; all POST /api/auth/* endpoints return 200 through the browser.
